title: F. Points
statement:
A triple of points i, j and k on a coordinate line is called beautiful if i < j < k and k - i ≤ d.

You are given a set of points on a coordinate line, initially empty. You have to process queries of three types:

The first line contains two integers q and d (1 ≤ q, d ≤ 2·10^5) — the number of queries and the parameter for defining if a triple is beautiful, respectively.

The second line contains q integers a_1, a_2, …, a_q (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 2·10^5) denoting the queries. The integer a_i denotes the i-th query in the following way:

For each query, print one integer — the number of beautiful triples after processing the respective query.

Input:
```
7 5
8 5 3 2 1 5 6
```

Output:
```
0
0
1
2
5
1
5
```
